purpose: Original backup-contract regions for targeted rollback.

regions.original:
18. **A backup that has never been extracted is a hypothesis.** Profile homes hold absolute symlinks, so a
    plain `tar czf` archive fails to restore (`LinkOutsideDestinationError`) — build it without `skills/`,
    snapshot `state.db` through the SQLite backup API, and make the script's own `--verify` extract and
    query the DB. One monthly job, rotate to the last N months in the same script. Recipe, include/exclude
    table → `references/profile-backup-restore.md`.
| `state.db` via `sqlite3.Connection.backup()` | consistent snapshot; a plain file copy can capture a torn WAL |

Write a `manifest.json` (file list, source path, timestamp) into the archive and have `--verify` assert
every listed file exists after extraction **and** that `state.db` opens and answers
`select count(*) from sessions`. A drill that only checks the tar exit code proves nothing.

Schedule it monthly, keep the last N months, and delete the oldest inside the same script — an
unrotated backup job turns into a disk leak (`--out ~/claw/backups/profiles/$(date +%Y-%m)`,
`ls -1d …/*/ | sort | head -n -3 | xargs rm -rf`). Emit one line on success, full output on failure.
